summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Roz Kelly, an American actress born July 29, 1943. It is best known for playing Carol "Pinky" Tuscadero, girlfriend of Arthur "Fonzie" Fonzarelli (played by Henry Winkler), on the television series Happy Days. The note is brief and gives no further career details.
one_line: Roz Kelly is an American actress best known for playing Pinky Tuscadero on the television series Happy Days.
